title: Onramp Snapshot Gallery: compact latency / cost / trace tiles for Quickstart
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact, exportable gallery of observability screenshots for the Quickstart flow: three-tile landing (latency distribution, cost-per-token sparkline, request trace waterfall), a single expanded trace view with hover callouts, and a dark/light variant set for docs and in-product help. Deliverables: Figma source, annotated PNG/WEBP exports at 2x and 3x, redacted sample datasets, and a handover note describing where to swap real telemetry. The assets will be used in the Quickstart doc, the onboarding modal, and the Console release notes.
comments: 2026-02-12 Maya Chen: Initial brief received from PM. Goal is to reduce cognitive load on first-run users; focus on three priority signals: latency distribution, cost-per-token, request traces.

2026-02-16 Ethan Park: First visual exploration uploaded to Figma (frames A/B). Chose a 3-up compact grid for landing and a single focused trace for deep-dive. Used synthetic but realistic token counts to avoid PII.
2026-02-18 Priya Rao (PM): Reviewed frames. Request to surface 95th percentile latency and average cost-per-token for the last 1h window; add a tiny usage caption for new users.

2026-02-20 Alex Nguyen (Engineering): Noted that our mock trace data must show KV cache hits vs misses to illustrate benefit. Suggested adding a dashed fallback lane representing model variant fallback for releases.
2026-02-24 Design critique: Color palette tweak to improve contrast. Approved annotation microcopy; reduced on-image copy to prevent localization issues.
2026-02-27 QA pass: Exports look consistent at 2x. Found rendering glitch in Chrome when overlays use fractional pixel shadows — fixed by snapping to pixel grid.
2026-03-01 Ethan Park: Submitting for final review. Attached export pack and handoff notes. Requesting engineering sign-off on the fallback lane depiction before release.
review_feedback: PM: Add inline legend mapping colors to percentiles (P50/P95/P99) and ensure the legend is accessible for color-blind palettes.
Engineering: Waterfall trace should include a small timeline ruler (ms) and a marker for KV cache prefetch events.
Docs: Request smaller caption variants for mobile doc viewer (reduce to two tiles stacked).
Design Lead: Approve dark mode; reduce drop shadow intensity for better printing and high-DPI exports.
decisions: Use anonymized synthetic telemetry with stable deterministic seeds for reproducibility.
Adopt 3-up compact grid as default Quickstart hero; single expanded trace available in docs and console help panel.
Export artifacts as PNG@2x and WEBP@3x plus SVG for individual sparkline components.
Keep on-image copy minimal; rely on caption blocks beneath frames for localization-friendly text.
Do not surface customer identifiers or real keys in any asset; all samples redacted and labeled SAMPLE.
Include explicit ARIA-friendly legend and ensure WCAG AA contrast for all variants.

Maya: Produce final export pack in PNG/WEBP/SVG and upload to gs://redwood-assets (due 2026-03-04).
Priya: Confirm metric naming in docs (P95 latency vs p95_latency) and update PRD if needed (due 2026-03-05).
Engineering: Sign off on visual representation of fallback lane and prefetch markers (ENG-2187).
Docs: Swap in final assets and validate mobile stacking behavior in the docs site (due 2026-03-10).
